description: This file defines an object named DeviceNames that provides a method to determine the best default device name for Android devices, using system settings or device build information.

classes.name: DeviceNames
classes.description: An object providing functionality to retrieve the device's default name.

methods.name: bestDefaultNodeName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the best default name for the device, attempting to retrieve it from system settings or constructing it from manufacturer and model information.
